status: provisional move names and numbers; source effects supplied by Preston

moves.name: Ember Flick
moves.brief: A small controlled spark from an ember vent.

moves.name: Vent Rake
moves.brief: A close foreclaw sweep that opens a brief line of heat.

moves.name: Coal Spit
moves.brief: A compact coal launched from the chest vents.

moves.name: Spineflare
moves.brief: A warning flare along the broken spine.

moves.name: Brow Shear
moves.brief: The swept brow shield cuts a hot arc.

moves.name: Clinker Toss
moves.brief: A heavy clinker knocked from the tail.

moves.name: Vent Row
moves.brief: Paired vents fire in sequence along the spine.

moves.name: Slagburst
moves.brief: Stored heat breaks through the shoulder crust.

moves.name: Crest Ram
moves.brief: The ram crest drives through a narrow opening.

moves.name: Club Cinder
moves.brief: A tail club throws a clinker at the target.

moves.name: Vent Barrage
moves.brief: The stepped ridge answers with repeated bursts.

moves.name: Furnace Roar
moves.brief: A full warning vent becomes a crushing blast.

moves.name: Signal Spark
moves.brief: A quick spark that marks the route ahead.

moves.name: Tail Brake
moves.brief: The forked tail snaps during a sudden stop.

moves.name: Shoulder Kindle
moves.brief: Paired shoulder sacs flash as it changes pace.

moves.name: Handoff Dash
moves.brief: A fast handoff step carries an ember through the target.

moves.name: Relay Arc
moves.brief: A sweeping heat signal from the forward shoulder.

moves.name: Shoulder Drive
moves.brief: The layered shoulder chambers propel a direct rush.

moves.name: Tail Shutter
moves.brief: The tail shutter opens just long enough to flash.

moves.name: Wayflare
moves.brief: A long run ends in a focused fireburst.

moves.name: Crest Signal
moves.brief: The split crest sends a distant fire signal.

moves.name: Furnace Bolt
moves.brief: The shielded chest furnace fires a compact bolt.

moves.name: Plate Rake
moves.brief: Plated haunches anchor a clawing strike.

moves.name: Longfire Burst
moves.brief: The runner releases heat saved over a long distance.

moves.name: Seam Spark
moves.brief: A thin spark escapes the furnace seam.

moves.name: Hex Cut
moves.brief: The faceted shell strikes along an angular edge.

moves.name: Ember Pellet
moves.brief: A small heat pellet rolls from under the shell.

moves.name: Kilnburst
moves.brief: The tucked chamber opens in a short blast.

moves.name: Glass Spur
moves.brief: An opened glass plate throws a sharp hot spur.

moves.name: Shield Flare
moves.brief: The raised shield reflects a narrow heat flash.

moves.name: Furnace Shard
moves.brief: A fractured plate carries heat from the protected chamber.

moves.name: Glassburst
moves.brief: The opened shell releases a broad asymmetric burst.

moves.name: Fracture Dart
moves.brief: A small hot shard breaks from a glass shelf.

moves.name: Window Flare
moves.brief: Heat escapes through fractured chamber windows.

moves.name: Plate Lunge
moves.brief: A shielding front plate becomes a piercing strike.

moves.name: Kiln Star
moves.brief: The guarded heat chamber releases a wide burst.
